powerOrigins.detail: Cosmic rays rewired his cells to make a far richer energy fuel, letting him turn his body into living flame at will.

abilities.name: Plasma flame form
abilities.detail: Turns all or part of his body into fiery plasma on command; bullets that do not melt pass straight through him. A vacuum or heavy soaking puts the flame out.

abilities.name: Fire shaping
abilities.detail: Throws fire as streams, spheres or skywritten words. Shapes last about three minutes unless he feeds them, and he can steer some fire he did not make.

abilities.name: Nova flame
abilities.detail: His hottest setting. A full nova burst dumps all his stored energy at around a million degrees Fahrenheit, then needs about twelve hours of recovery.

abilities.name: Flight
abilities.detail: Rides a cloud of hydrogen and flame jets at about 140 mph, and can push to supersonic speed, enough to keep pace with the Silver Surfer in orbit.

abilities.name: Heat control and absorption
abilities.detail: Raises or lowers the temperature around him even when not alight, and can soak up outside flames to snuff them out.

abilities.name: Fire and heat immunity
abilities.detail: Fire and heat below his own peak output cannot harm him, flaming or not.

abilities.name: Mechanic, driver and fighter
abilities.detail: A gifted mechanic since his teens who helped design the second Fantasticar, an experienced race driver, and a capable brawler trained by the Thing.

feats.text: Carried across space with the Watcher's help, he reached Galactus's worldship and brought back the Ultimate Nullifier that forced Galactus to spare Earth.
feats.where: Fantastic Four Vol 1 #49 to #50 (April to May 1966)
